title: Xanthe and the Compass
author: Theo Voss
blurb: Silas Pemberton, a bush pilot flying medicine and rumors into the interior, knows the wilderness forgives nothing and forgets less. But when a government survey team vanishes, leaving gear and no tracks, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
